notes.title: Star Chef Simulator | Update v0.4.1
notes.content:
[b]Update v0.4.1 is now available! Check out numerous changes and improvements, including balancing and bug fixes.[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug of level achievements not triggering at correct level
[*] Fixed bug of crockery cabinet only recognizing upgrade on the next day
[*] Fixed bug of upgrading tooltip showing $0 instead of $∞ in sandbox mode
[*] When in sandbox mode, all available upgrades are now unlocked by default
[*] Fixed bug where customer tooltip patience progress bar didn't update correctly when customer group
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Massively improved transfering calculation
[*] When grabbing items from an inventory, they're now correctly aligned to your crockery
[*] Employees now have a minimum endurance of 40 (Will update for your current employees as well after you've finished a day)
[*] Edited manual text for "Transfering"
[*] Increased probability of fire
[*] Fires will no longer spawn at the same time
[*] Decreased rice cooker cooking time from 60 to 30 seconds
[*] Added tooltip for rice cooker and flour pan
[*] Waiters now always grab the menu book at the top
[/list]

[b]Your feedback is crucial to the further development of Star Chef Simulator. If you have any suggestions, comments or discovered bugs in the game, please feel free to share them with us using the Steam forum or our Discord server.[/b]

notes.title: Star Chef Simulator | The Asian Food Update
notes.content:
[b]The Asian Food Update (v0.4.0(.1)) is now available. This is the third major content update and the biggest one so far. We've added new dishes, many customization options and new cooking mechanics. Enjoy making Sushi with the Bamboo Mat or cooking Rice with the Rice Cooker. Our team has collected feedback from content creators and the community to add quality of life features and improve the over all game flow![/b]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some walls not updating correctly when customizing them
[*] Fixed bug of window mode not updating correctly
[*] Fixed bug of Linux version not starting correctly
[*] Fixed bug that tree shadows disappeared sometimes
[*] Fixed wrong translations
[*] Fixed bug of storeman teleporting into bins
[*] Fixed bug of keybinding mouse icons not showing correctly sometimes
[*] Fixed bug of subtitle text showing "<Subtitle>" in tutorial
[*] Fixed bug that tutorial continued even if lights were turned off
[*] Fixed bug that tutorial didn't continue when exiting the tablet with [ESC] or [TAB]
[*] Fixed bug of subtitle widget preventing you from exiting tooltip widgets at 150% UI scale
[*] Fixed bug of liquids not being displayed in tooltip widget
[*] Fixed bug of pinned recipe not updating correctly in shop app
[*] Fixed "lights went out" event triggering in tutorial
[*] Fixed bug of customer groups being counted as one in statistics
[*] Finally fixed bug of level up animation not waiting until game unpaused or time skipping finished
[*] Items can no longer get attached on a new crockery when already on a crockery
[*] Implemented a fix to prevent crockery from breaking when dropping dish on customer table
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added animation for keybinding buttons
[*] Edited some groceries icons
[*] Added sound when transfering from package box
[*] Some texture loading optimization
[*] Adjusted random skill values of employee applications
[*] Reworked deep fryer oil material
[*] Fires now only can spawn when machine was turned on before
[*] Increased probability of fires
[*] Removed piracy protection for Linux version
[*] Increased probability of bad weather
[*] Improved scrolling of subtitle widget
[*] Increased max item capacity of hotel pans to 12
[*] Improved collision of square plate and eggplant slice
[*] Changed sensitivity and FOV settings to sliders
[*] Slightly changed design of settings menu
[*] Increased interact range from 175 to 200
[*] Game now auto-sets your language on first startup to OS default (resets your language selection once)
[*] Game shows widget now when saving (can be disabled in settings)
[*] Made one easter egg always visible
[*] Improved UI scaling of several widgets
[*] You now can also completely close tooltip widgets with clicking the background
[*] Customers now always order drinks in tutorial
[*] Water tap now automatically turns on when using the sponge
[*] Increased max XP per dish from 20 to 25 in level 0 & 1
[*] Decreased unlock levels of some drinks & dishes
[*] Player now stays signed-in in developer menu
[*] You're now able to stop skipping time with pressing [ESC]
[*] Added a few new names
[*] Adjusted bush & grass color
[*] Overhauled customer spawning system
[*] Added "(p)" to all recipes if grocery is needed partially only
[*] Decreased size of UI elements on personalization screen (first startup)
[*] New design of news section in main menu
[*] Decreased calculated water costs
[*] Groceries in package boxes are longer durable now
[/list]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added one new wall texture for customization
[*] Added new easter egg
[*] Added new flouring mechanic
[*] Added new wet knife mechanic
[*] Added new items: salmon filet, rice, flour, green asparagus, nori, avocado, chili
[*] Added new spices: sesame, wasabi, soy sauce
[*] Added new dishes: Teriyaki Salmon, Maki Sushi
[*] Added new drinks: Edelhopfen Beer, Sake
[*] Added new tools: scissors, bamboo mat, rice cooker
[*] Added 4 new table decoration options
[*] Added 4 customization options for exterior lights
[*] Added glasses on tables (customizable)
[*] Added 3 new achievements
[*] Added new UI theme "dark red"
[*] Added HDR support (beta)
[*] New decoration in level
[*] Added construction site to level
[*] You can now click dishes on the menu to "fast-travel" to them
[*] Added table number system (visible in mini map)
[*] Added screen to kitchen where you can see all pending orders
[*] You can now spawn sticky notes to write instructions/reminders for yourself [Q]
[*] Added 3 new loading screen backgrounds
[*] Added Bluesky button to main menu
[*] You can now grab groceries directly into a crockery when holding it and pressing [RMB]
[*] Added introduction tooltip when first playing the tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: Star Chef Simulator | Community Update 02
notes.content:
[h2]The Asian Food Update (March)[/h2]
It has been some time since the last update and we would like to share some information about the [b]latest development[/b]. We're actively working on [b][u]The Asian Food Update[/u][/b], which will be the [b]third major content update[/b] and is ought to [b]release in March[/b]. There will be [b]more dishes[/b], new [b]customization options[/b] for your restaurant, many [b]level design improvements[/b], and much more cool stuff - stay tuned!
[i]However, the update will be slightly smaller than the last major updates, as we're preparing for the updates in Q2, Q3, and the[/i] [b][u]Bakery DLC in Q4[/u][/b] [i]in the background. Thanks for your patience![/i]

[h2]Steam Cloud Support Update[/h2]
Star Chef Simulator now supports the [b]Steam Cloud for Linux[/b], to store save games[b] across devices[/b] & [b]different platforms[/b]. This means you're able to continue running your restaurant on [b]SteamOS (Steam Deck)[/b], Windows or Linux and v. v.

notes.title: Star Chef Simulator | The Employee Update
notes.content:
[b]The Employee Update (v0.3.0) is now available. This is the second major content update for Star Chef Simulator. We've added new job types, many customization options and reworked the employee system. Our team has collected feedback from content creators and the community to add quality of life features and improve the over all game flow![/b]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed that the light flickering event was triggered while skipping time
[*] Fixed bug where time skipping sometimes didn't stop when a customer arrived
[*] Fixed that you were able to call customers when day wasn't started in sandbox
[*] Fixed bug of employee tooltip showing -1 employed days
[*] Fixed bug of employee model changing every time
[*] Fixed bug of waiter not bringing two menu books when two customers at table
[*] Fixed bug of dishwasher collecting crockery which had already been picked up by the player
[*] Fixed bug of customer tooltip not showing state sometimes
[*] Fixed bug of customers sometimes switching menu books
[*] Fixed bug of shop not showing order costs in spanish translation
[*] Fixed bug of shop showing the wrong order costs when first opening it
[*] Fixed bug of dish rating widget not showing grocery names in russian translation
[*] Fixed bug of dish rating widget being stuck on screen when its show option was disabled
[*] Fixed bug of profits statistics displaying wrong values in overview widget
[*] Fixed bug of bloody mary drink not being available in shop app
[*] Fixed bug of container tooltip not displaying content correctly
[*] Fixed that customer amount per day was counted and displayed wrong in career mode
[*] Fixed bug of customer amount per day always showing 0 in sandbox mode
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added name headline to all inventories
[*] Added message when you call a new customer in sandbox mode
[*] Improved filter for offensive words
[*] Customization is now available with level 4
[*] Employees are now available with level 6
[*] Employees now keep their rotation when changing their job
[*] Added absent counter to employee app
[*] Slightly changed design of progress bars in tooltips
[*] Slightly improved performance of NPCs
[*] Added new customer animations
[*] When 30FPS are set as limitation camera motion gets disabled
[*] You can no longer gain XP in sandbox mode
[*] Level up animation now waits until game unpaused or time skipping finished
[*] You can no longer pin drinks as recipe
[*] Added ordering limit in tutorial, so players don't order too much
[*] Slightly changed customer spawn rate
[*] Slightly decreased fridge sound volume
[*] UI texture loading optimization
[/list]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Released Steam Cloud storage for Windows users (not cross-platform) on 01.12
[*] Added accessibility option for increasing UI scale
[*] Added chinese language
[*] Added new item mob
[*] Added puddle cleaning mechanic
[*] Customers react if restaurant is dirty
[*] Added customizable table decoration
[*] Added customizable table clothes 
[*] Added 3 new table designs
[*] Added 2 new chair designs
[*] Added shopping cart presets for easier ordering
[*] Added new employee jobs cleaner and storeman
[*] You can now send employees to training courses, so they improve their abilities
[*] Storeman orders the cart presets you selected when fridge is nearly empty
[*] Added facial animation for customers when speaking
[*] You can now display custom image files on the screen in your restaurant
[*] Added auto sort feature for inventories
[*] Added mail system, so employees can send mails to you
[/list]

notes.title: Star Chef Simulator | Community Update 01
notes.content:
[h2]The Employee Update (December)[/h2]
It has been some time since the last update and we would like to share some information about the [b]latest development[/b]. We're actively working on [b][u]The Employee Update[/u][/b], which will be the [b]second major content update[/b] and is ought to [b]release this December[/b]. There will be [b]new jobs[/b] for the employees, [b]training courses[/b] are implemented, new [b]customization options[/b], and much more cool stuff. [b]Below are a few sneak-peeks.[/b]

[h3]Steam Cloud support[/h3]
Star Chef Simulator now supports the[b] Steam Cloud[/b] to [b]store saves across devices[/b] (This is currently[b] limited to Windows users[/b] and [b]does not work across different platforms[/b]).

[h3]More customization options[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015087/c6c860155017e9bb9bbf70f40379ea6eb35009e0.png[/img]
[i]We're adding multiple new decoration & customization options for your restaurant.[/i]

[h3]New cleaning mechanics + employee jobs[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015087/98825bdbd30ecc5da3d8e440232bcdf739644846.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015087/f2508a2e42149a65cacd078d813d2897c4c27e28.png[/img]
[i]Wish, wish, wish - we unlocked the toilet rooms![/i]🧽🫧[i]But not only you'll have to clean![/i]

[h3]New feature: shopping cart presets[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015087/3500e04777ea2e12fabdf3939234b75c7d083e39.png[/img]
[i]Tired of rearranging your shopping cart? With the new shopping cart presets, you can easily save your order as a preset and insert it whenever it's needed.[/i]

[h3]New feature: employee training courses[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015087/0f47ac50a4b9808e4b4b1aa96f22566cc105405b.png[/img]
[i]You can now send your employees to training courses so they improve their skills.[/i]

notes.title: Star Chef Simulator v0.1.5
notes.content:
[b]Update v0.1.5 is now available! We have collected the received feedback over the last few days and tried to implement it in this patch. Among other improvements, it's now easier to make progress and unlock new dishes. The tutorial has been slightly reworked and we've tried to clear up ambiguities for the player.[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]    Fixed bug of [E] not getting displayed in package box tooltip
[*]    Fixed bug of subtitle covering key info
[*]    Fixed bug of personalization options not loading
[*]    Fixed bug of customers giving 50% dish rating when ordered no drink
[*]    Fixed bug that you could order without paying delivery fee
[*]    Fixed bug that you didn't received payment if cooking rating widget was disabled
[*]    Fixed bug that subtitle text was displayed too small
[*]    Fixed bug that you were stuck if a rating widget displayed while being in an inventory
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]    dollar sign is now always before the number
[*]    Increased XP reward for washing
[*]    Increased allowed camera angle for falling items
[*]    Increased patience of couple customers by 50%
[*]    Increased max dish XP reward until level 4 to 20
[*]    Improved animation of the delivery man
[*]    Improved collision of square bowl
[*]    Removed express order option
[*]    Removed "place package" task from tutorial
[*]    Decreased price of red wine
[*]    Decreased volume of fridge sounds
[*]    Groceries now expire 30% slower
[*]    Moved knife block
[*]    Music while playing option is now in audio tab
[*]    Overworked startup personalization screen
[/list]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]    Released roadmap in "NEWS" section
[*]    Customers now tip
[*]    Added tooltip widgets
[*]    Added new manual category "garbage"
[*]    Added accessibility option for crosshair coloring
[/list]

[b]We've also released the roadmap for Star Chef Simulator:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015087/07ad7a00b05870b5575f4100045685ce68c03c33.png[/img]
[i]We reserve the right to modify the roadmap at any time.[/i]
